mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which is associated with wage inflation and potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for corporate earnings and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25 basis points in a single meeting signals a hawkish monetary policy stance, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases > 25bps.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer confidence and demand, which is a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both increase.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which is a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy, which is a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases for 3 consecutive months.
